title: ClaudeFoundry profile
description: A declarative, composable unit of coding standards, steering documents, skills, agents, and commands that ClaudeFoundry can apply to a project.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the profile schema itself, not the profile's own version. Bump only when this schema changes incompatibly.

name.description: Kebab-case, unique within the profile library (or within the project for a custom profile).

extends.description: Parent profile(s) whose `provides` this profile inherits. A field this profile also defines overrides the parent's; fields it omits are inherited unchanged.

requires.description: Other profiles that must also be applied whenever this one is selected. The composer includes them automatically and records why.

conflictsWith.description: Profiles that cannot be selected together with this one. The composer refuses to silently pick a winner and reports the conflict for the user to resolve.

detect.description: Advisory evidence only. Indicators raise or lower confidence that a project uses this profile's technology; they are never treated as conclusive proof on their own.

overridableComponents.description: Component ids (instruction/steeringDoc/rule ids) that a user is explicitly allowed to override without that being flagged as tampering.

profileRef.description: A profile name, optionally pinned to a version with @major.minor.patch.

commands.description: Build/test/lint/validate commands this profile contributes, e.g. { "build": "dotnet build", "test": "dotnet test" }. Kept namespaced per profile by the composer, so same-named commands from different technologies in a full-stack composition never collide.

path.description: Target file path, relative to the consuming project's root.
